title: Conventions
description: Where each element type's code is, and what opt-in rules look for (rules.md, Locating an element's code; Opt-in rules). In a single-file pack, the `conventions` section holds one of these per designer, keyed by designer, without `designer`.

types.description: Keyed by element specialization: one convention, or several each narrowed by `where`

injected.description: Parameters the framework supplies, which operation.parameters and parameter.* skip (rules.md, Locating an element's code)

type.description: A parameter type's name, simple or qualified

annotation.description: An attribute or annotation on the parameter, such as FromServices

results.description: Result wrappers operation.returns unwraps, beyond the language profile's async ones: T marks the result, … any further type arguments (ActionResult<T>, Results<Ok<T>, …>, ResponseEntity<T>)

members.description: unmodelled.member conventions beyond an element type's own member kinds

files.description: Globs narrowing a convention within scope; they never widen it

where.description: Narrows the convention to the elements this expression is true for

typeKinds.description: The kinds the element's type may be: type.kind's expected value. Locating looks among every kind.

locations.description: Globs relative to the output folder; placeholders allowed

name.description: The type's name: {Name} is the element's name, with the placeholder filters (I{Name}, {Name|trimEnd:Service}Controller); defaults to the language profile's naming

find.description: unmodelled.type: optional; a find path that narrows the rule, within the convention's files, to the types it reaches

states.description: unmodelled.member: the kinds of member the element type can state. The last pack whose convention for the element type says wins; none: the rule doesn't look inside its types

uniqueNames.description: unmodelled.member: the designer gives each of the element type's members a name of its own, so of a type's methods of one name (overloads) only one can be stated: none is asked for when one is located, else only the first. The last pack whose convention for the element type says wins; absent: false

kind.description: How findings name this kind of code

name.description: How a finding names each place: {Class}, {Method}, {Member}, {Name}, {File}, $1…
